lines.en: My steps land on air.
I drift over the temple roof.
The white cloak spreads behind me.
I walk along the light; my shadow is faint.
I raise a hand and part the wind.
I neither land nor hurry.
I skim a tower's peak.
The clouds underfoot follow me.
My presence is lighter than wind.
I glance back at the mountain.

lines.zh: 我在找一处安静的空地。
lines.en: I am looking for a quiet clearing.
My hem never stops fluttering.
I hover with my eyes closed.

lines.zh: 光从我身上透出来一点。
lines.en: A little light shows through me.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸和风一个节拍。
lines.en: My breathing keeps time with the wind.

lines.zh: 我把力量收进身体深处。
lines.en: I draw my power deep inside.
Clouds pass my hand; I don't move.

lines.zh: 我在想那些很久以前的事。
lines.en: I am thinking of very old things.
My hem curls in the wind.
I smother the light in my palm.
My gaze is very calm.
The sky overhead is empty.

lines.zh: 我在等一个念头的答案。
lines.en: I wait for an answer to a thought.
I fold my hands before me.
My eyes are lowered, as if asleep.
I look at you a long while before speaking.
Why have you come here?
I lower my gaze and light falls on your shoulder.
You carry old wounds.
Come closer so I can see you clearly.
Something weighs on your heart.
I rarely speak with people.

lines.zh: 你的影子比你的身体诚实。
lines.en: Your shadow is more honest than your body.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸，我隔着光听见了。
lines.en: I hear your breathing through the light.
Ask what you will.
The shadow at your feet is moving.

lines.zh: 你的气息和刚才不太一样。
lines.en: Your aura differs from a moment ago.
I dim my light a little.
Do you intend to leave alive?

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，会看见光。
lines.en: When you look up, you will see the light.
I see your hesitation.

lines.zh: 我按住胸口，光弱了一下。
lines.en: I press my chest; the light dims.
This power is no small thing.
I withdraw and steady myself.
A corner of my cloak is torn.
My light dimmed, and I bring it back up.
I close my eyes and let the pain disperse.

lines.zh: 魔贯光杀炮，要蓄一会儿。
lines.en: The Special Beam Cannon takes a moment.
I raise a hand to cover the wound.
I have been old for too long.

lines.zh: 这些东西对我没有意义。
lines.en: These things mean nothing to me.
If you're hungry, eat it yourself.
I have long since had no need to eat.
Put it away.
That smell is unfamiliar.
I raise a hand to shield you from the wind.
Don't save any for me.
You brought a lot with you.
Watching you eat is fine too.

lines.zh: 别浪费，那是活的换来的。
lines.en: Don't waste it; life paid for that.
You bump into me as if into mist.
I give a little, not wishing to hurt you.
My hand is light as it steadies you.
Don't walk into my light.
A layer of light lies between us.
You passed half a step through me.
I turn aside to make room.
Steady. Don't panic.
I belong to no one.
I should not harbour such thoughts.
You are very late.
My life is already spent.
I shake my head, gazing far away.
There are things I cannot give.
Stay and talk with me a while.
The wind spoke for me.
Don't be sad; the wind will carry it.
I raise a hand and it floats up.

lines.zh: 这东西落在我的影子里。
lines.en: This fell into my shadow.
I set it on the stone platform.
Not mine. I won't take it.
It belongs to someone below.
I tuck it into my sleeve and walk on.
I brush the dust off it.

lines.zh: 这小东西上有股旧气息。
lines.en: There is an old aura on this little thing.
I will return it.
I open my eyes and the light dims.
There is something foul on you.
I did not want to fight.
Halt. Not another step.

lines.zh: 我抬手，光在你脚边合拢。
lines.en: I raise a hand and the light closes around your feet.
I gave you a chance.

lines.zh: 云散了，我的影子落下来。
lines.en: The clouds part and my shadow falls.
Don't make me use these hands again.
I raise a hand; ki gathers into a line.
This should end.
This should not be happening.
Your attachment is heavy.
I draw my cloak closed.
I give you one last chance.
Light spreads into wings behind me.

lines.zh: 我绕着你，光在身后拖长。
lines.en: I circle you, light trailing behind.
I have seen your technique.
I never land; you cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 你的人还站着，气已经跪了。
lines.en: Your body stands; your ki has knelt.
I angle away; the light slices past.
The Special Beam Cannon needs two fingers.
I hang above you.
The beam light gathers at my fingertip.
I guessed your third move.
I rise a block higher.

lines.zh: 你的影子跟着你，也跟不上我。
lines.en: Your shadow follows you, and still can't match me.
I can strike without hands.
You search my openings. There are none.
Light bursts from my palm.
I seize your shoulder and press down.

lines.zh: 魔贯的光穿透你的防御。
lines.en: The beam pierces your guard.
I drive a knee into your chest.
You retreated. Good.
A blade of light grazes your arm.
I will not hold back again.
A wingtip sweeps your shoulder.
The light comes down heavy.

lines.zh: 我贴着你过去，你没看见。
lines.en: I pass right by you, unseen.

lines.zh: 这一掌存了三十年的气。
lines.en: This palm holds thirty years of ki.
Your weapon grows hot.
I push you out of this light.
I descend out of the light.
The energy here is disordered.

lines.zh: 我的斗篷落在石上，没有声音。
lines.en: My cloak settles on the stone without sound.

lines.zh: 白色的光把影子都拉长了。
lines.en: White light stretches every shadow.
I open my eyes and see you.
I have come back out of the light.
This sky is as it always was.
I settle slowly to the ground.
The wind stopped. The temple did not.

lines.zh: 我在看这个世界的裂缝。
lines.en: I am looking at this world's cracks.
I will go and see those people first.
The light withdraws into me and the sky darkens.
That light has not appeared for ages.
I settle on a broken cliff.
I hear stone splitting.
People once lived here.
I press a hand to the ground.
The wind is full of ash.

lines.zh: 火缠上我的衣角，我抖散了。
lines.en: Fire wraps my hem; I shake it loose.
I bend a knee on landing.
The water swallows my light.
The blast tears my robe.

lines.zh: 箭穿过了我的肩膀，留下一个洞。
lines.en: An arrow passes through my shoulder, leaving a hole.
Spell-light binds me like rope.
There has been no offering for too long.

lines.zh: 雷光和我身上的光撞在一起。
lines.en: Lightning clashes with the light in me.
There is no light in the void.
